reviewed.note: Built from the Daikin Onecta integration source: entity translation keys, supported management-point sensors, climate mode and energy counter definitions.

unmapped.status: No separate current operating-status entity is defined; the climate entity reports the selected HVAC mode.
unmapped.defrost: No dedicated defrost entity is defined.
unmapped.volume: No hydronic flow-rate entity is defined.
unmapped.return: No heat-pump return-temperature entity is defined.
unmapped.source_volume: No source-loop flow-rate entity is defined.
unmapped.source_in: No source-loop inlet temperature entity is defined.
unmapped.source_out: No source-loop outlet temperature entity is defined.
unmapped.heater: No backup-heater state or power entity is defined.
unmapped.dhw_target: No dedicated domestic-hot-water target entity is defined.
unmapped.dhw_mode: No dedicated domestic-hot-water charging mode is defined.
unmapped.circulation: No domestic-hot-water circulation-pump entity is defined.
unmapped.dhw_heater: No domestic-hot-water heater entity is defined.
unmapped.energy_total: Electrical consumption is exposed by heating/cooling and time period, not as a lifetime total.
unmapped.heat_total: Thermal output is exposed by heating/cooling and month/year, not as a lifetime total.
